content: We need to list elements that can be definitively identified based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool to get spectrum. Then analyze isotopic patterns to identify elements like Cl (35/37 pattern), Br (79/81), S (32/34/33), etc. Also C has M+1 pattern (13C). But definitive identification likely limited to elements with distinctive isotopic patterns: Cl, Br, S, maybe Si? But we need to see actual spectrum. Let's retrieve spectrum.
